items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: So I run into Earl Hines. Earl Hines told me, he says, 'Now, I'll tell you something... I'll make a man out of him.'

ctx.x: Well, it's stupid really, any way you look at it.
Well, Earl Warren. In fact, Earl
Warren, he could really tell you some good stories. I know he's told you some.
